title: Syrian Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender vegetables and aromatic spices, inspired by the cuisine of Syria.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lettuce, stew vegetables, herbal tea, crushed red pepper, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs or a dollop of yogurt, if desired.
